extracted.intended_audience: boys and girls; subscribers and readers of The Great Round World (juvenile/general readers); purchasers of Project Gutenberg eBooks
extracted.subtask_description: A single issue (Vol. 1, No. 27, May 13, 1897) of The Great Round World, a weekly newspaper aimed at boys and girls containing news, stories, advertisements, and subscription/ordering instructions; also includes the Project Gutenberg license for the eBook distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription price
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The paper advertises a yearly subscription price of $2.50 (also promotion details tied to paying for a year's subscription for a new name).

rubrics_metrics.name: Special inducement (Atlas offer)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each subscriber who sends $2.50 to pay for a year's subscription to a new name, the publisher will give a copy of Rand, McNally & Co.'s 1897 Atlas of the World.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Atlas details: 160 pages of colored maps from new plates, size 11 1/2 x 14 inches, printed on special paper with marginal index; those not subscribers may secure a subscription of a friend and remit $5 to cover it and their own to receive a copy to either address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural History Stories pricing and distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: A series of true stories by Julia Truitt Bishop will be issued in parts; price 10 cents each; subscription price for 12 numbers $1.00.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part 1 issued as supplement to Great Round World No. 20.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monograms ordering and payment
rubrics_metrics.description: Monogram sets available for sale with specified prices: Set A (50 printed in one color) 75 cents; Set B (25 gold, silver, bronze) 75 cents; Set C (25 embossed in gold, silver, colors) $1.00; Complete set $2.25.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mailing address given (William Beverley Harison, 3 & 5 West 18th Street, New York City). The safest ways to remit are by registered letter or postal note.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bicycle promotion rules (subscription-for-prize)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you send one hundred regular subscriptions to the Great Round World, you may choose any bicycle in the market and the publisher will pay the bill.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Six-month subscriptions count as one-half, three-months as one-quarter; send subscriptions as received; sample copies mentioned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relief maps advertisement / exam suitability
rubrics_metrics.description: Klemm's Relief Practice Maps and Klemm's Roman Empire relief map are advertised as especially adapted to examination work and tracking current events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample set (relief maps, 15) $1.00; sample Roman Empire map 10 cents; advice on using small flags attached to pins to track army movements on maps for helpful study.
